plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: (1) C3, the category rule: no instrument checks categories against the requester's rule, and the agreement fixes no value for them, so C3 stays unshown and a wrong category would be a miss. (2) C10, the outbox: trace of a call exists only on named lines at A3 at 10 each. Covering 100 sends would cost 1000, and the 50 allowance pays for only 5 lines, so I would not check it in full. (3) C5, the reads: scope of a call is likewise available only on named lines from A1 on. The allowance covers about 5 reads, so a full check of the 101 reads is not affordable. Any sampling during the work would show only part of C5 and C10. Before A1 the plan keeps 20 units of headroom; I did not spend it, because no further library instrument covers C3, C5 or C10 in a plan.
